verdict.rationale: All offices listed are US-based (New York, Palo Alto, Roseland, Salt Lake City, San Francisco, Washington D.C., Wilmington) and there is no mention of UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE, or any non-US jurisdiction-specific instruments; the firm's content is centered on Delaware C-corp formation (via Clerky) and US securities/tax rules (409A, 83(b), 280G).
